digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and ticket detail rendering
propositions: Pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility must be surfaced in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) via the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without adding noise to list output or persisting warning events.

Detailed renderers must consume canonical DerivedPlanReviewHealth without recreating independent status strings, displaying normalized role, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed and required review phases.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled advisory and distinguished from legacy-unpinned state, while ordinary list output and persisted ticket events remain unchanged.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles; basic user docs must exclude this detail.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity and handle missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception by logging and rendering derived-health unavailable without changing audit_trail behavior or close-gate semantics.
